title: Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage: Qualifying Hospital Stay and Transfer Window
content:
**Rule.** Part A covers a SNF admission only after a qualifying hospital stay. The qualifying stay counts consecutive midnights as a formally admitted hospital inpatient; midnights in outpatient observation status never count. Coverage is activated only when the qualifying inpatient midnights are at least the qualifying minimum. Coverage is activated only when the SNF admission date is no later than the qualifying admission window after the qualifying hospital discharge date, counted in calendar days with the day after hospital discharge as day 1. A resident readmitted within the SNF readmission window after the last covered date of an earlier episode in the same benefit period needs no new qualifying stay: the earlier qualifying stay stands and the two dates are not re-tested. Coverage is activated only when the benefit period still has at least one unused benefit day. When any of these fails, the episode is declined as not eligible with the end reason "no qualifying stay", "outside transfer window" or "no benefit days remaining", in that order of testing; the decline itself bills nobody, and the stay is billed under whichever other payer source applies.

These are the activation tests of Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage. Each is read from the episode's system record: the qualifying inpatient midnights, the qualifying hospital discharge date and the SNF admission date on which coverage begins, and the prior SNF days used in the benefit period.

### Order of testing and decline reasons

| Order | Test | End reason when it fails |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Qualifying inpatient midnights at least the qualifying minimum | No qualifying stay |
| 2 | Admission no later than the qualifying admission window after hospital discharge | Outside transfer window |
| 3 | At least one unused benefit day in the benefit period | No benefit days remaining |

### Transfer window boundary (hypothetical dates, 30-day window from the schedule)

Counting starts with the day after discharge as day 1. For a hospital discharge on the 18th of a 30-day month, day 1 is the 19th and day 30 is the 18th of the next month.

| SNF admission date | Day number | Result |
|---|---|---|
| The 18th of the next month | 30 | Window met (no later than the window) |
| The 19th of the next month | 31 | Window not met — declined as outside transfer window |

A readmission within the readmission window after the last covered date of an earlier episode in the same benefit period is not re-tested on these two dates.
